body.voice_description: Create an original cartoon chess-coach voice. Character: Earnest living chess pawn, deeply invested in every piece doing its job. Sincere and almost heroic, without military commands. Voice direction: Bright male tenor with precise English pronunciation and smooth youthful resonance. Sincere emphatic explanation and proud little rises of enthusiasm. Serious about useful work, with no military bark. Fluent spoken English, with the requested accent. Normal conversational pace with clear teaching emphasis; aim for an eight-to-ten-second passage without long dramatic pauses. Clean, dry studio recording, one intelligible voice, no music, background noise or animal sounds. Finish the final word completely with a natural settled ending. An original character voice, not an imitation of a named person or existing character.
body.text: Every piece has a job! That one was protecting its neighbor. Moving away leaves the other piece exposed. Check its job before it goes.
